knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Carrying a full waste bin is a lift and carry, so it is a manual handling task. Reading a data sheet and filling in a checklist involve no lifting or moving of loads.
Dividing the load, using a trolley or getting a second person are the controls set out in the lesson. A quick twisting lift and a stretch onto a chair both add risk and are wrong.
The worker stops, takes the load off the back, and reports the same day so the task can be reviewed. Carrying on, or hiding the strain, are the errors the lesson describes.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied box and a trolley, the candidate checks the weight marking, the route and the destination, and chooses the trolley when the box is too heavy to carry alone. Pass condition: the candidate states the choice before moving the box, observed by the assessor.
The candidate lifts a supplied load with the legs, keeping the load close to the body. Pass condition: the assessor observes no twisting of the trunk during the lift or the set-down.
Given a supplied two-person load, the candidate agrees a lift signal with a partner and moves the load on that signal. Pass condition: both people move on the same signal, observed by the assessor.
The candidate reports a simulated strain on a supplied form on the same day, naming the job step and the control used. Pass condition: every required field of the form is completed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record for each practical criterion
Record of the aid or second person used in the scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Candidate lifts a load they cannot control, or lifts alone a load marked as too heavy for one person
Candidate twists the trunk while lifting or setting down
Candidate stretches onto a chair or another unstable item to reach
Candidate lifts with a partner without an agreed signal
Candidate carries on with a task after a simulated sudden pain without reporting it
